key_facts.value_en: 1954 (the predecessor Liuzhou Agricultural Machinery Factory was founded on 6 October 1954); vehicle production began in 1969
key_facts.value_zh: 1954 年（前身柳州农业机械厂于 1954 年 10 月 6 日创立）；1969 年进入汽车生产领域
中国广西壮族自治区柳州市

key_facts.value_en: State-owned. Direct shareholders on the company profile: Dongfeng Motor Group Company Limited 75% and Guangxi Liuzhou Industrial Investment & Development Group Co., Ltd. 25%. The brand-history page calls Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor a controlled subsidiary of Dongfeng Motor Corporation. The listed company's 2024 results announcement states that its holding company and ultimate holding company is Dongfeng Motor Corporation.
key_facts.value_zh: 国有。公司概况所载直接股东：东风汽车集团股份有限公司持股 75%、广西柳州市产业投资发展集团有限公司持股 25%。品牌历史页称东风柳汽是东风汽车集团有限公司的控股子公司。港交所 2024 年业绩公告写明，股份公司的控股公司及最终控股公司是东风汽车集团有限公司。

key_facts.value_en: Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor Co., Ltd., held 75% by Dongfeng Motor Group Company Limited and 25% by Guangxi Liuzhou Industrial Investment & Development Group Co., Ltd.
key_facts.value_zh: 东风柳州汽车有限公司，由东风汽车集团股份有限公司持股 75%、广西柳州市产业投资发展集团有限公司持股 25%

key_facts.value_en: Not separately listed (the brand and its operating company do not publish standalone financial statements)
key_facts.value_zh: 未单独上市（品牌及运营主体不单独披露财务报表）

key_facts.value_en: Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor sold 133,000 vehicles (up 12% y/y); commercial vehicles up 40.3%, new-energy commercial vehicles up 181%, new-energy passenger vehicles up 25.1%
key_facts.value_zh: 东风柳汽 2025 年销量 13.3 万辆（同比 +12%）；其中商用车 +40.3%、新能源商用车 +181%、新能源乘用车 +25.1%

key_facts.value_en: Projected full-year exports of more than 53,000 units (up 23.5%, per the December 2025 forecast); overseas exports set a record high for a third consecutive year
key_facts.value_zh: 2025 年预计出口超过 5.3 万辆（同比 +23.5%，为 2025 年 12 月预计口径）；全年海外出口连续三年创历史新高

key_facts.value_en: Passenger-vehicle brand Forthing (东风风行) and commercial-vehicle brand Chenglong (乘龙)
key_facts.value_zh: 乘用车品牌「东风风行」与商用车品牌「乘龙」

key_facts.value_en: Annual capacity of 400,000 passenger vehicles, 100,000 commercial vehicles and 100,000 engines
key_facts.value_zh: 年产 40 万辆乘用车、10 万辆商用车、10 万台发动机

history.event_en: Liuzhou Agricultural Machinery Factory, the predecessor of Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor, is founded on 6 October 1954.
history.event_zh: 东风柳汽前身柳州农业机械厂于 1954 年 10 月 6 日创建。

history.event_en: Liunong produces Guangxi's first vehicle, the 'Liujiang'-brand truck (a CS130-type 2.5-tonne truck), ending the history of Guangxi only being able to repair vehicles rather than produce them.
history.event_zh: 柳农研制并生产广西第一辆汽车「柳江」牌载货汽车（CS130 型 2.5 吨载货汽车），结束广西只能修车不能产车的历史。

history.event_en: Guangxi Liuzhou Motor Manufacturing Factory is formally established on 31 March 1973.
history.event_zh: 3 月 31 日，广西壮族自治区柳州汽车制造厂正式挂牌成立。

history.event_en: On 17 February, Liuzhou Motor joins the Dongfeng Motor Industry Corporation, shifting its products from the 'Liujiang' and 'Guangxi' brands to the 'Dongfeng' brand.
history.event_zh: 2 月 17 日，柳汽加入东风汽车工业联营公司，产品由「柳江」「广西」牌向「东风」牌转型。

history.event_en: On 18 July the Liuzhou Automobile Works is restructured into Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor Co., Ltd., with Dongfeng Motor Company holding 75% and the Liuzhou state-asset operating company holding 25%.
history.event_zh: 7 月 18 日，柳州汽车厂改制为东风柳州汽车有限公司，东风汽车公司持股 75%、柳州市国有资产经营公司持股 25%。

history.event_en: Dongfeng Liuzhou launches the Lingzhi MPV, described as China's first self-owned-brand MPV; the 'Fengxing' (Forthing) passenger-vehicle brand is born.
history.event_zh: 9 月推出 MPV 风行菱智（被称为国内首款自主品牌 MPV），「风行」乘用车品牌由此诞生。

history.event_en: Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor is brought into Dongfeng Motor Co., Ltd., the Dongfeng-Nissan joint venture, and adopts Nissan management practices. The brand-history page does not state an equity split. That 2003 joint-venture arrangement was later replaced by the shareholding now on the company profile: Dongfeng Motor Group Company Limited 75% and Guangxi Liuzhou Industrial Investment & Development Group Co., Ltd. 25%. The pages cited here do not give the date of the change.
history.event_zh: 柳汽整体进入东风与日产的合资公司（东风汽车有限公司），全面导入日产管理模式。品牌历史页未写股比。这一 2003 年的合资公司安排，后来被公司概况页现在披露的股权取代：东风汽车集团股份有限公司 75%、广西柳州市产业投资发展集团有限公司 25%。所引页面没有写明转出合资公司的日期。

history.event_en: The brand-history page says that in December 2010 sales revenue exceeded RMB 10 billion and production and sales passed 100,000 units for the first time. The company history page says 2010 sales revenue broke through RMB 12 billion and annual production and sales passed 100,000 units. Both pages are official; the revenue figures differ and are shown together.
history.event_zh: 品牌历史页写 2010 年 12 月销售收入超百亿元，产销首次突破 10 万辆。公司发展历程页写 2010 年销售收入突破 120 亿元，年产销首次突破 10 万辆。两页都是官网，收入数字不一致，此处并列。

history.event_en: Phase one of the Liudong passenger-vehicle base, with 200,000-unit annual capacity, is completed and put into production.
history.event_zh: 产能 20 万辆的柳东乘用车基地一期竣工投产。

history.event_en: Forthing holds its 'Fengxing³ Evolution' brand night at the Water Cube and unveils the T5 EVO.
history.event_zh: 「风行³进化论」品牌之夜在水立方举行，T5 EVO 亮相。

history.event_en: Forthing refreshes its brand under the 'Chengfeng Plan', switching all models to the new 'Jinshi' (lion) badge.
history.event_zh: 品牌焕新发布「乘风计划」，全系切换「劲狮标」。

history.event_en: Forthing announces its new-energy strategy and unveils the Leiting pure-electric SUV.
history.event_zh: 发布新能源战略，首款纯电 SUV 风行雷霆亮相。

history.event_en: The Leiting, Forthing's first pure-electric SUV, launches in seven versions priced RMB 129,900-229,900; Forthing also states a plan to invest over RMB 20 billion in new-energy competitiveness and to stop producing fuel vehicles by 2030.
history.event_zh: 东风风行首款纯电 SUV 风行雷霆上市，共 7 款车型、指导价 12.99 万–22.99 万元；东风风行并宣布将投入超 200 亿元构建新能源竞争力、2030 年停产燃油车。

history.event_en: Forthing releases the 'Xinghai' (Star Sea) new-energy series on 18 April; the V9 MPV begins global pre-sale.
history.event_zh: 4 月 18 日，东风风行新能源序列「风行星海」正式发布，首款车型星海 V9 同步开启全球预售。

history.event_en: The Xinghai V9 mid-to-large MPV launches in Guangzhou at RMB 199,900-279,900 across five versions in the 'Chinese Knot' and 'Qingyun Ladder' series.
history.event_zh: 星海 V9 中大型 MPV 在广州上市，官方售价 19.99 万–27.99 万元，含「中国结」「青云梯」两个序列共 5 个配置。

history.event_en: The Xinghai S7 electric sedan launches in Qingdao at RMB 119,800-139,900 across three versions.
history.event_zh: 星海 S7 纯电轿车在青岛上市，官方售价 11.98 万–13.99 万元，共 3 个配置版本。

history.event_en: At the 9th '67 Brand Customer Day', Dongfeng Liuzhou releases the overseas 'Chengfeng Twin-Engine (2030)' plan: RMB 20 billion cumulative investment, nine overseas smart manufacturing bases, 300+ new sales networks and annual overseas sales of 300,000 units by 2030.
history.event_zh: 第九届 67 品牌客户日发布海外「乘风双擎（2030）」计划：至 2030 年累计投入 200 亿元、共建 9 个智能制造基地、新增 300 家以上销售网络、实现年海外销售 30 万辆。

history.event_en: Forthing holds a brand launch in Bangkok and officially enters the Thai market, debuting the right-hand-drive FRIDAY SUV and the V9.
history.event_zh: 东风风行在泰国曼谷举行品牌发布会，正式进入泰国市场，右舵新能源 SUV FRIDAY 与星海 V9 亮相。

history.event_en: At the 10th '67 Brand Customer Day', Dongfeng Liuzhou releases its '15th Five-Year Plan' ('725·Dual Leadership') strategy, signs a Huawei Qiankun cooperation agreement to equip the Xinghai series with Huawei intelligent driving, and launches the 2027 Xinghai V9.
history.event_zh: 第十届 67 品牌客户日发布「十五五」战略（「725·双领先」），举行风行星海搭载华为乾崑智驾合作签约，并官宣 2027 款星海 V9 上市。

history.event_en: The Xinghai V6 opens national pre-sale in Chengdu on 8 August in four versions; the RMB 89,900 entry is the guide price of the 400 km luxury trim, not a Qiankun pre-sale price. The pre-sale article calls the intelligent-driving system the latest ADS 5.0.
history.event_zh: 8 月 8 日，星海 V6 在成都开启全国预售，共 4 款车型；其中 8.99 万元为 400km 豪华型指导价，而非乾崑版预售价。预售稿称智驾系统为最新版 ADS 5.0。

history.event_en: At Dongfeng Liuzhou's autumn product launch, the Xinghai V6 officially launches in three Huawei Qiankun versions. The launch article calls the system ADS SE; the August pre-sale article calls it the latest ADS 5.0. The launch-period super trade-in price starts at RMB 99,900. Dongfeng Liuzhou reports cumulative January-August sales of 89,439 units (up 26%).
history.event_zh: 东风柳汽 2026 秋季新品发布会举行，星海 V6 正式上市。上市稿称华为乾崑智驾 ADS SE 版 3 款，8 月预售稿称最新版 ADS 5.0；上市期间超级置换价低至 9.99 万元起。公司披露 1–8 月累计销售 89,439 辆、同比 +26%。

brands.role_en: Forthing's founding product line and commercial/utility MPV range, positioned as a 'wealth-creation tool' for entrepreneurs.
brands.role_zh: 东风风行起家产品线与商用兼用 MPV 序列，定位面向创业者的「创富工具」。
brands.owner_note_en: Launched in September 2001 and described as China's first self-owned-brand MPV. The family's 1.1-millionth vehicle rolled off the line in April 2023.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2001 年 9 月推出，被称为国内首款自主品牌 MPV；2023 年 4 月第 110 万辆下线。

brands.role_en: Mid-to-large PHEV MPV, the first model of the Xinghai new-energy series, positioned as a 'luxury smart-electric first-class cabin'.
brands.role_zh: 中大型插电混动豪华 MPV，风行星海序列首款车型，定位「豪华智电头等舱」。
brands.price_band: China launch price RMB 199,900-279,900 (June 2024); 2027 model official guide price RMB 179,900-229,900, with super trade-in price RMB 169,900-219,900 (June 2026)
brands.owner_note_en: Launched on 1 June 2024 in five versions (Chinese Knot / Qingyun Ladder series). A refreshed 2027 model launched in June 2026, with more than 20 upgrades. Xinhua reports a length of 5,230 mm and a 3,018 mm wheelbase, 200 km CLTC pure-electric range and 1,300 km CLTC combined range. Width and height are not stated in the cited pages. Debuted overseas as the FORTHING V9 in Thailand in March 2026.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2024 年 6 月 1 日上市，共 5 个配置（中国结/青云梯序列）。2026 年 6 月焕新上市 2027 款，全车 20 余项升级。新华网写车长 5230 毫米、轴距 3018 毫米，CLTC 纯电续航 200 公里、CLTC 综合续航 1300 公里。所引页面没有车宽和车高。2026 年 3 月以 FORTHING V9 之名在泰国首秀。

brands.role_en: Xinghai-series sedan. The 26 September 2024 launch was a pure-electric family sedan. The brand-history page also records a 650 km long-range version on 21 December 2024 and a range-extender version launched at the Shanghai Auto Show on 24 April 2025.
brands.role_zh: 星海序列轿车。2024 年 9 月 26 日上市的是纯电家用轿车。品牌历史页另记 2024 年 12 月 21 日 650 公里长续航版发布，以及 2025 年 4 月 24 日增程版在上海车展上市。
brands.price_band: September 2024 pure-electric launch price RMB 119,800-139,900, three versions. The brand-history page records a 650 km long-range version on 21 December 2024 and a range-extender launch on 24 April 2025, and does not give prices for those later versions.
brands.owner_note_en: Launched on 26 September 2024 in three pure-electric versions. A 30 August 2024 Forthing article gives a 0.191 drag coefficient, a 555 km range, an 11.9 kWh/100 km energy consumption and a 68.53% high-strength-steel ratio. That article does not name a test cycle such as CLTC. The product line later added the December 2024 650 km long-range version and the April 2025 range-extender.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2024 年 9 月 26 日上市，共 3 款纯电配置。2024 年 8 月 30 日东风风行稿写风阻系数 0.191、续航 555 公里、百公里电耗 11.9 千瓦时、高强钢占比 68.53%，该稿未写 CLTC 等测试循环。其后还有 2024 年 12 月的 650 公里长续航版和 2025 年 4 月的增程版。

brands.role_en: Large six-seat family vehicle and the first Xinghai model with Huawei Qiankun intelligent driving, positioned as an affordable family large six-seater. The August 2026 pre-sale article calls the system the latest ADS 5.0; the 19 September 2026 launch article calls it ADS SE.
brands.role_zh: 大六座家用车型，风行星海首款搭载华为乾崑智驾的车型，定位「智慧亲民大六座」。2026 年 8 月预售稿称最新版 ADS 5.0，2026 年 9 月 19 日上市稿称 ADS SE 版。
brands.price_band: August 2026 pre-sale, four versions: 510 km Qiankun flagship pre-sale RMB 124,900; 400 km Qiankun premium pre-sale RMB 104,900; 510 km premium guide price RMB 104,900; 400 km luxury guide price RMB 89,900. The 19 September 2026 launch article states three Qiankun ADS SE versions and a launch-period super trade-in price from RMB 99,900. It does not state a launch guide-price band of RMB 104,900-124,900 or a benefit-price band of RMB 99,900-119,900.
brands.owner_note_en: Named as the landing model when Dongfeng Liuzhou signed the Huawei Qiankun cooperation in June 2026. National pre-sale opened on 8 August 2026 in Chengdu with four versions: 510 km Qiankun flagship pre-sale RMB 124,900, 400 km Qiankun premium pre-sale RMB 104,900, 510 km premium guide RMB 104,900 and 400 km luxury guide RMB 89,900. It officially launched on 19 September 2026 in three Qiankun versions, with a launch-period super trade-in price from RMB 99,900 (the launch article says this is the first time Huawei Qiankun intelligent driving went below RMB 100,000). The pre-sale article calls the system the latest ADS 5.0; the launch article calls it ADS SE. Body 4,835 mm long with a 2,900 mm wheelbase and a 2+2+2 layout (a seven-seat version is also offered), with a stated 510 km range. The pre-sale article says 510 km real range and does not name CLTC.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2026 年 6 月东风柳汽与华为乾崑签约时被点名为落地车型。2026 年 8 月 8 日于成都开启全国预售，共 4 款车型——510km 乾崑旗舰型预售价 12.49 万元、400km 乾崑尊享型预售价 10.49 万元、510km 尊贵型指导价 10.49 万元、400km 豪华型指导价 8.99 万元。2026 年 9 月 19 日正式上市，上市稿称乾崑智驾 ADS SE 版共 3 款（8 月预售稿称最新版 ADS 5.0），上市期间超级置换价低至 9.99 万元起，系华为乾崑智驾首次进入 10 万元以内。车长 4835 毫米、轴距 2900 毫米，2+2+2 六座布局（另提供 7 座版）。预售稿写 510 公里真续航，未写 CLTC。

brands.role_en: Forthing's first pure-electric SUV, positioned as a 'pure-electric SUV populariser'.
brands.role_zh: 东风风行首款纯电 SUV，定位「纯电 SUV 普及者」。
brands.price_band: China launch price RMB 129,900-229,900 (March 2023), seven versions
brands.owner_note_en: Launched on 25 March 2023 in seven versions, equipped with the 'armour' battery and Huawei's TMS 2.0 heat-pump thermal management. At the launch, Forthing also stated a plan to invest over RMB 20 billion in new-energy competitiveness and to stop producing fuel vehicles by 2030.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2023 年 3 月 25 日上市，共 7 款车型，搭载「铠甲电池」与华为 TMS2.0 热泵热管理系统。发布会上东风风行并宣布将投入超 200 亿元构建新能源竞争力、2030 年停产燃油车。

brands.role_en: Compact SUV line under the refreshed 'Jinshi' brand era, aimed at young first-time buyers.
brands.role_zh: 品牌焕新后的紧凑型 SUV，面向年轻首购人群。
brands.owner_note_en: Unveiled at the November 2020 brand night and launched nationwide in March 2021.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2020 年 11 月品牌之夜亮相，2021 年 3 月全国上市。

brands.role_en: Seven-seat family vehicle launched in July 2022.
brands.role_zh: 2022 年 7 月上市的七座家用车。
brands.owner_note_en: Launched in July 2022. The 17 September 2026 Dongfeng Liuzhou article records the launch of the Dongfeng Forthing U-TOUR in Myanmar and does not state the powertrain.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2022 年 7 月上市。2026 年 9 月 17 日东风柳汽稿记载「东风风行 U-TOUR 缅甸上市」，该稿未写动力类型。

brands.role_en: Commercial-vehicle brand of Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor, covering tractors, cargo trucks, dump trucks, special vehicles and new-energy commercial vehicles; a sister brand to Forthing.
brands.role_zh: 东风柳汽旗下商用车品牌，涵盖牵引车、载货车、自卸车、专用车及新能源商用车，是东风风行的姊妹品牌。
brands.owner_note_en: Operated by Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor alongside Forthing. In 2025 the company's commercial-vehicle sales rose 40.3% and new-energy commercial vehicles rose 181%. The new-energy commercial platform brand 'Chenglong Yiwei' made its global debut in June 2025, and in June 2026 the company showed the Chenglong H7 PRO hydrogen version and the Chenglong Yiwei 5 electric heavy truck on the group's T1 platform.
brands.owner_note_zh: 与东风风行同属东风柳汽。2025 年公司商用车销量同比 +40.3%、新能源商用车同比 +181%。2025 年 6 月新能源商用车平台品牌「乘龙翼威」全球首发，2026 年 6 月又在集团 T1 平台基础上展示乘龙 H7 PRO 氢耀版与乘龙翼威 5 超能版电动重卡。

financials.note_en: Forthing is a passenger-vehicle brand of Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor Co., Ltd. and is not separately listed, so it publishes no standalone financial statements; financials.rows is empty and no brand-level revenue, gross margin, net profit or R&D figures are disclosed or estimated here. Accordingly, no net-profit attribution (to owners of the parent versus ordinary shareholders) is stated for the brand. The operating entity, Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor Co., Ltd., is also unlisted and its results are consolidated into Dongfeng Motor Group Company Limited (0489.HK). That listed company's consolidated financial statements are prepared under International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), per note 2.1 of the 2024 annual report published on 29 April 2025 (https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2025/0429/2025042902925.pdf). The interim condensed consolidated financial information for the six months ended 30 June 2025 is prepared under IAS 34, per the interim report published on 22 August 2025 (https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2025/0822/2025082202324.pdf). This note does not describe those consolidated statements as prepared under PRC GAAP. Consolidated group data belongs in the Dongfeng Motor Group deep-dive. This page provides factual disclosures only and does not constitute any trading recommendation.
financials.note_zh: 东风风行是东风柳州汽车有限公司旗下的乘用车品牌，未单独上市，亦不单独披露财务报表，故 financials.rows 为空数组；品牌层面的营收、毛利率、净利润、研发投入等均未单独披露，本研究不做估算，因此不在此处标注净利润属于「归属于母公司股东」还是「归属于普通股股东」的口径。运营主体东风柳州汽车有限公司亦未上市，其财务并入东风汽车集团股份有限公司（0489.HK）合并报表。该上市公司对外合并财务报表按国际财务报告准则（IFRS）编制，见 2024 年报附注 2.1（2025-04-29，https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2025/0429/2025042902925.pdf）。截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日止六个月的中期简明合并财务资料按《国际会计准则第 34 号》编制（2025-08-22，https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2025/0822/2025082202324.pdf）。此处不把上述合并报表写成按中国企业会计准则编制。母集团合并财务数据请见「东风汽车集团」深度研究。本页仅为事实性披露，不构成任何交易推荐。

overview.en: Forthing (东风风行, Fengxing) is the passenger-vehicle brand of Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor Co., Ltd. in Liuzhou. The brand-history page calls that company a controlled subsidiary of Dongfeng Motor Corporation (东风汽车集团有限公司) [s1]. The company profile states the direct shareholders as Dongfeng Motor Group Company Limited (东风汽车集团股份有限公司) with 75% and Guangxi Liuzhou Industrial Investment & Development Group Co., Ltd. with 25% [s2]. The 2024 annual results announcement of the listed company states that its holding company and ultimate holding company is Dongfeng Motor Corporation, a state-owned enterprise established in the PRC [s25]. Its predecessor, the Liuzhou Agricultural Machinery Factory, was founded in 1954 and entered vehicle production in 1969; the Forthing brand was born in September 2001 with the Lingzhi MPV, described as China's first self-owned-brand MPV [s1]. Today the brand spans MPVs, SUVs and sedans plus the Xinghai new-energy series released in April 2024 (V9, S7, V6), running alongside the Chenglong commercial-vehicle brand of the same company [s2]. In 2025 Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor sold 133,000 vehicles, up 12% year-on-year, with commercial vehicles up 40.3%, new-energy commercial vehicles up 181% and new-energy passenger vehicles up 25.1% [s4]. Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor says it has won the trust of nearly 2 million global customers [s17]. The brand is not separately listed and publishes no standalone financials; the parent group is covered in the Dongfeng Motor Group deep-dive [s2].
overview.zh: 东风风行（Fengxing / Forthing）是总部位于广西柳州的东风柳州汽车有限公司的乘用车品牌。品牌历史页称东风柳汽是东风汽车集团有限公司的控股子公司[s1]。公司概况写直接股东为东风汽车集团股份有限公司持股 75%、广西柳州市产业投资发展集团有限公司持股 25%[s2]。港交所 2024 年业绩公告写明，股份公司的控股公司及最终控股公司是在中国成立的国有企业东风汽车集团有限公司[s25]。其前身柳州农业机械厂创立于 1954 年、1969 年进入汽车生产领域；2001 年 9 月，东风风行以 MPV 菱智诞生，该车型被称为国内首款自主品牌 MPV[s1]。品牌现覆盖 MPV、SUV、轿车及 2024 年 4 月发布的「星海」新能源序列（V9、S7、V6 等），与同属东风柳汽的商用车品牌「乘龙」并行[s2]。2025 年东风柳汽销量 13.3 万辆、同比 +12%，其中商用车 +40.3%、新能源商用车 +181%、新能源乘用车 +25.1%[s4]。东风柳汽表示已累计收获近 200 万全球客户信赖[s17]。品牌不单独披露财务数据、也未单独上市，母集团情况见「东风汽车集团」深度研究[s2]。

current.en:
Business structure

Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor runs two brands: the Forthing passenger-vehicle brand (MPV, SUV, sedan, pure-electric MPV and pure-electric sedan) and the Chenglong commercial-vehicle brand (tractors, cargo trucks, dump trucks, special vehicles and pure-electric logistics and sanitation vehicles) [s2]. In 2025 the company sold 133,000 vehicles, up 12% year-on-year, with commercial vehicles up 40.3%, new-energy commercial vehicles up 181% and new-energy passenger vehicles up 25.1% [s4]. At its December 2025 partner conference the company forecast 2025 terminal sales of 145,300 units (up 22.9%), with more than 50,000 commercial vehicles sold (up 43%) and new-energy sales above 8,200 units (up 140%) [s11]. In H1 2026 the Forthing brand sold 42,371 units, up 40% year-on-year [s15]; by July 2026 Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor had cumulatively sold 82,807 units (up 33%) [s12], and by August 89,439 units (up 26%) [s22]. Domestically the company has nearly 2,500 marketing and service outlets covering more than 30 provinces, and nearly 300 overseas outlets serving more than 70 countries and regions [s2].

Technology and platforms

The Xinghai series builds on Dongfeng's EMA modular platform and Mach power. The EMA platform covers SUVs, MPVs and sedans with wheelbases from 2,615 mm to 3,000 mm, supports pure-electric, plug-in hybrid and range-extender powertrains, and holds an ASEAN-NCAP five-star safety rating [s17]. Forthing's powertrain and safety portfolio includes the Mach hybrid engine, an 800V silicon-carbide electric drive, the 'armour' battery that has passed more than 500 tests, and the Xinghai Pilot L2 assisted-driving system [s17]. A 30 August 2024 Forthing article gives the Xinghai S7 a 0.191 drag coefficient, a 555 km range, an 11.9 kWh/100 km energy consumption and a 68.53% high-strength-steel ratio; that article does not name a test cycle such as CLTC [s19]. The brand-history page also records a 650 km long-range version released on 21 December 2024 and a range-extender version launched at the Shanghai Auto Show on 24 April 2025, so the S7 line is not only the September 2024 pure-electric car [s1]; the 2027 Xinghai V9 uses the Mach hybrid with 200 km CLTC pure-electric and 1,300 km combined range [s21]. From June 2026, Forthing deepened cooperation with Huawei to equip the Xinghai series with Huawei Qiankun intelligent driving, landing first on the V6 [s4]. On the commercial side, Dongfeng Liuzhou first showed the group's T1 hydrogen-electric platform at the June 2026 customer day and released the Chenglong H7 PRO hydrogen version and the Chenglong Yiwei 5 electric heavy truck [s4].

Factories and capacity

Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor occupies about 5,180 mu (3.454 million square metres) and operates the Liudong commercial-vehicle and passenger-vehicle bases, with annual capacity of 100,000 commercial vehicles and 400,000 passenger vehicles; its B+ engine project builds EW-series 2.0 and 1.8T engines at 100,000 units per year [s2]. The company also runs full-vehicle environment and NVH laboratories and a proving ground that simultaneously supports passenger vehicles under 3.5 tonnes and commercial vehicles up to 55 tonnes [s2].

Domestic position

Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor is one of Dongfeng's 'four bases' in the south: a commercial-vehicle base, passenger-vehicle base, self-owned-brand R&D base and Southeast-Asia export base [s2]. Forthing was founded in the MPV segment, where the Lingzhi has long served the commercial/utility MPV niche; for the '15th Five-Year Plan' the company targets 250,000 passenger vehicles focused on the MPV track [s4].

Overseas business

A 17 September 2026 Dongfeng Liuzhou article says the business covered more than 120 countries and regions, with eight KD plants in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Africa and Central Asia, and more than 200 overseas sales and service networks [s6]. A 19 September 2026 article on the same site says overseas KD plants had reached nine [s22]. The two official figures, two days apart, are both shown here. In 2025 overseas exports rose 32.7% year-on-year, covering more than 80 countries and regions (per the Thailand-market release) [s17]; the company's corporate profile page states products are sold to more than 70 countries and regions through nearly 300 overseas outlets, a differing figure presented here alongside the newer one [s2]. In the first eight months of 2026, overseas whole-vehicle exports surpassed 33,000 units [s6]. On 9 March 2026 Forthing held a brand launch in Bangkok and entered the Thai market, debuting the right-hand-drive FRIDAY SUV and the V9 [s17]. On 16 September 2026 the Pinglu Canal opened. It is 134.2 km long. Dongfeng Liuzhou's passenger-vehicle KD kits were among the first cargoes and were sent through the canal toward ASEAN [s6]. The same article says the canal can shorten the sea route for cargo from southwest China by more than 560 km. That distance is about southwest cargo in general, not a stated saving on Dongfeng Liuzhou's own KD shipment [s6]. In ASEAN the company plans three '10,000-unit markets': Vietnam (led by the KD plant), Thailand (right-hand-drive passenger vehicles) and Indonesia (a reserve market) [s6]. In Thailand, Forthing said it will gradually build a nationwide sales and service network and introduce more family models [s17].
current.zh:
业务结构

东风柳汽运营两大品牌：乘用车品牌「东风风行」（MPV、SUV、轿车、纯电动 MPV 与纯电动轿车）与商用车品牌「乘龙」（牵引车、载货车、自卸车、专用车及纯电动物流车、纯电动环卫车）[s2]。2025 年公司销售 13.3 万辆、同比 +12%，其中商用车 +40.3%、新能源商用车 +181%、乘用车新能源 +25.1%[s4]。据 2025 年 12 月合作伙伴大会（预计口径），公司 2025 年预计实现终端汽车销量 14.53 万辆、同比 +22.9%，其中商用车全年实销超 5 万辆、同比 +43%，新能源销量突破 8200 辆、同比 +140%[s11]。2026 年上半年东风风行销量 42,371 辆、同比 +40%[s15]；截至 2026 年 7 月，东风柳汽累计销售 82,807 辆、同比 +33%[s12]，1–8 月累计销售 89,439 辆、同比 +26%[s22]。渠道上，公司在国内拥有近 2500 个营销服务网点、覆盖 30 多个省市自治区，海外拥有近 300 个营销服务网点、产品远销 70 余个国家和地区[s2]。

技术与平台

星海序列基于东风 EMA 模块化平台与马赫动力：EMA 平台覆盖 SUV、MPV、轿车三大车系，轴距覆盖 2615–3000 毫米，兼容纯电、插混、增程，并获 ASEAN-NCAP 五星安全认证[s17]。动力与安全上，东风风行手握获评「中国心十佳发动机」的马赫混动高效发动机、全域 800V 高压碳化硅电驱总成，以及历经 500 余项严苛测试的「铠甲电池」，并搭载星海 Pilot L2 级智能驾驶辅助系统[s17]。2024 年 8 月 30 日东风风行稿写星海 S7 风阻系数 0.191、续航 555 公里、百公里电耗 11.9 千瓦时、高强钢占比 68.53%，该稿未写 CLTC 等测试循环[s19]。品牌历史页另记 2024 年 12 月 21 日星海 S7 650 公里长续航版发布、2025 年 4 月 24 日星海 S7 增程版在上海车展上市，因此 S7 的产品现状不只有 2024 年 9 月那次纯电上市[s1]；2027 款星海 V9 采用马赫混动，CLTC 纯电 200 公里、综合 1300 公里[s21]。2026 年 6 月起与华为深化合作，风行星海将搭载华为乾崑智驾，首款落地车型为星海 V6[s4]。商用车侧，东风柳汽在第十届 67 品牌客户日首次展示集团 T1 氢电平台成果，并发布乘龙 H7 PRO 氢耀版与乘龙翼威 5 超能版电动重卡[s4]。

工厂与产能

东风柳汽占地面积约 5180 亩（345.4 万平方米），拥有柳东商用车、乘用车两大新生产基地，具备年产 10 万辆商用车、40 万辆乘用车生产能力；已投建 B+ 发动机项目生产 EW 系列 2.0、1.8T 发动机，形成 10 万台/年产能[s2]。公司建有整车环境模拟试验室、NVH 试验室等大型综合试验室，并建成同时满足 3.5 吨以下乘用车及最大至 55 吨商用车整车开发的专业试验场[s2]。

国内市场地位

东风柳汽是东风公司在南方的商用车生产基地、乘用车生产基地、自主品牌研发基地和东南亚出口基地「四大基地」之一[s2]。东风风行起家于 MPV 市场，菱智长期深耕商用兼用 MPV 细分；面向「十五五」，公司提出乘用车冲刺 25 万辆、聚焦 MPV 赛道[s4]。

海外业务

2026 年 9 月 17 日东风柳汽稿写业务已覆盖全球 120 多个国家和地区，在东南亚、中东、非洲、中亚等区域建成 8 座 KD 工厂，海外销售和服务网络超过 200 家[s6]。2026 年 9 月 19 日同一官网的秋季发布会稿写海外 KD 工厂已达 9 家[s22]。两份官网稿相差两天，数字不同，此处并列。2025 年海外出口同比增长 32.7%、覆盖 80 多个国家和地区（泰国市场发布稿口径）[s17]；公司官网「公司概况」页则写产品远销 70 余个国家和地区、海外近 300 个营销服务网点，与较新稿件口径存在差异，此处并列呈现[s2]。2026 年 1–8 月，东风柳汽海外整车出口突破 3.3 万辆[s6]。2026 年 3 月 9 日，东风风行在泰国曼谷举行品牌发布会，右舵新能源 SUV Friday 与星海 V9 亮相，正式进入泰国市场[s17]。2026 年 9 月 16 日平陆运河通航，全长 134.2 公里，东风柳汽乘用车 KD 件作为首航货物之一，经运河发往东盟[s6]。同一篇稿写西南货物出海航程可缩短 560 公里以上。这 560 公里以上说的是西南货物出海航程，不是东风柳汽 KD 件自身航程的缩短数字[s6]。在东盟，公司规划打造越南（依托 KD 工厂）、泰国（右舵乘用车）、印尼（战略储备）三个「万辆级」市场[s6]。在泰国，东风风行表示将逐步搭建覆盖全泰国的销售与服务网络，并持续引入更多家用车型[s17]。

leadership.en:
Founder

Forthing has no private founder. It is a brand of Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor Co., Ltd., whose predecessor Liuzhou Agricultural Machinery Factory was founded on 6 October 1954 and became a Dongfeng subsidiary in the late 1990s [s1].

Management

  • Zhang Xiaofan (张小帆) — Dongfeng Motor News, dated 26 December 2025, reports the 23 December 2025 commercial-vehicle partner conference and names him party secretary and general manager of Dongfeng's commercial-vehicle business division and chairman of Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor [s11]. The company leadership page does not list a chairman [s2]. The 8 June 2026 customer-day article, the September 2026 canal article and the 19 September 2026 launch article do not repeat his name, so this page does not treat the chairmanship as reconfirmed as of 29 October 2026 [s4][s6][s22].
  • Lin Changbo (林长波) — general manager of Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor, concurrently deputy general manager of Dongfeng's commercial-vehicle business division [s11]; the company's corporate profile page also lists him as general manager [s2]. The 19 September 2026 launch article still names him general manager [s22].
  • Liu Xiaoping (刘小平) — party secretary of Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor [s2]. The canal article about the 16 September 2026 opening, published on the company site with source date 17 September 2026, still names him party secretary [s6].
  • Weng Tianxiao (翁天晓) — deputy general manager and chief accountant [s2].
  • Yan Zongyun (鄢宗云) — secretary of the discipline inspection commission [s2].
  • Bao Dan (包丹) — deputy party secretary [s2].
  • Cheng Yuan (程源) — deputy general manager [s2].

The formal appointment dates of these executives are not separately disclosed in the sources reviewed here [s2][s11].

Ownership and governance

Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor is 75% held by Dongfeng Motor Group Company Limited and 25% by Guangxi Liuzhou Industrial Investment & Development Group Co., Ltd., a wholly state-owned structure [s2]. The brand itself has no separate board of directors and discloses no standalone ownership structure; the listing and governance of its listed parent, Dongfeng Motor Group Company Limited, are covered in the Dongfeng Motor Group deep-dive [s2].
leadership.zh:
创始人

东风风行无民营意义上的单一创始人，是东风柳州汽车有限公司打造的乘用车品牌；其前身柳州农业机械厂 1954 年 10 月 6 日创建，1990 年代末改制成为东风下属企业[s1]。

管理层

  • 张小帆——东风汽车报 2025-12-26 的稿件报道 12 月 23 日商用车合作伙伴大会，称他为东风汽车商用车事业部党委书记、总经理、东风柳汽董事长[s11]。官网领导团队页没有董事长[s2]。2026 年 6 月 8 日客户日稿、9 月平陆运河稿和 9 月 19 日上市稿都没有再出现这个姓名，因此本页不把董事长一职写成截至 2026-10-29 仍经这几份稿件复核[s4][s6][s22]。
  • 林长波——东风柳汽总经理，同时任东风汽车商用车事业部副总经理[s11]；东风柳汽官网「领导团队」页亦列其为总经理[s2]。2026 年 9 月 19 日上市稿仍称他为总经理[s22]。
  • 刘小平——东风柳汽党委书记[s2]。记述 2026 年 9 月 16 日通航、来源日期为 2026-09-17 的运河稿仍称他为党委书记[s6]。
  • 翁天晓——副总经理、总会计师[s2]。
  • 鄢宗云——纪委书记[s2]。
  • 包丹——党委副书记[s2]。
  • 程源——副总经理[s2]。

各高管的正式上任日期在本次检索到的来源中未单独披露[s2][s11]。

股权与治理

东风柳汽由东风汽车集团股份有限公司持股 75%、广西柳州市产业投资发展集团有限公司持股 25%，为国有全资结构[s2]。品牌层面无独立董事会，亦无单独披露的股权结构；其上市公司母公司东风汽车集团股份有限公司的上市与治理情况见「东风汽车集团」深度研究[s2]。

competition.en:
Competitive position: our assessment

Our assessment: Forthing competes mainly in the MPV segment, where the Lingzhi line has been a long-standing incumbent, and enters the mainstream RMB 100,000-250,000 new-energy market through the Xinghai series, where it faces the large established players that dominate that price band [s4]. Its scale is modest: 133,000 vehicles in 2025 is small against the segment leaders [s4]. The Xinghai models enter at low prices: the S7 launched from RMB 119,800 [s9], the 2027 V9 is guided from RMB 179,900 [s21], and the V6 launched with a launch-period super trade-in price from RMB 99,900 [s22]. The above is based on the sales, product and pricing data cited in this study.

Strengths and constraints: our assessment

Our assessment: Forthing's strengths are its MPV heritage and the Lingzhi line's 'wealth-creation tool' positioning [s1], Dongfeng's manufacturing and supply-chain backing as one of the group's southern bases [s2], and low entry pricing on the Xinghai models [s9]. Its constraints are a limited brand presence in the mainstream new-energy market and no dominant technology label in the RMB 100,000-200,000 band. Cited 2025 results do not break out sales by model, so this assessment does not treat volume as dependent on the Lingzhi line [s4]. The Huawei Qiankun partnership from 2026 is intended to fill the technology gap in the family large-six-seat segment, but that segment is itself competitive. The above is based on the sales, product and pricing data cited in this study.
competition.zh:
竞争地位：我们的判断

我们的判断：东风风行主要竞争于 MPV 细分市场——凭借菱智深耕多年——并通过星海序列切入 10 万–25 万元主流新能源市场，该市场由多家头部企业主导[s4]。其体量偏小：2025 年东风柳汽销量 13.3 万辆、同比 +12%，与主流新能源市场头部玩家差距明显[s4]。星海序列以低起售价进入市场：星海 S7 上市价 11.98 万元起[s9]，2027 款星海 V9 官方指导价 17.99 万元起[s21]，星海 V6 上市期间超级置换价低至 9.99 万元起[s22]。上述判断依据为本研究所引销量、产品与价格数据。

优势与约束：我们的判断

我们的判断：东风风行的优势在于 MPV 积淀与菱智系列的「创富工具」定位[s1]、作为东风南方基地的制造与供应链支撑[s2]，以及星海车型的低起售价[s9]。其约束在于主流新能源市场品牌声量不足、10 万–20 万元价格带缺乏绝对技术标签。所引 2025 年成绩没有分车型销量，因此这一判断不把销量写成依赖菱智序列[s4]。2026 年起与华为乾崑的合作意在补齐家用大六座市场的技术短板，但该细分市场竞争激烈[s4]。上述判断依据为本研究所引销量、产品与价格数据。

outlook.en:
Company plans

Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor's '15th Five-Year Plan' ('725·Dual Leadership') strategy, released in June 2026, sets commercial vehicles at 70,000 units (leading the southern regional market), passenger vehicles at 250,000 units (focused on the MPV track), and overseas sales of 155,000 units by 2030, described as 'rebuilding a Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor overseas' [s4]. The earlier 'Chengfeng Twin-Engine (2030)' plan, released in June 2025, targeted cumulative investment of RMB 20 billion, nine overseas smart manufacturing bases and 300+ new sales networks by 2030, with an initial annual overseas sales target of 300,000 units [s5][s13]; by 2026 official releases stated that plan's overseas target as 155,000 units [s6]. In ASEAN it plans three '10,000-unit markets': Vietnam (led by the KD plant), Thailand (right-hand-drive passenger vehicles) and Indonesia (a reserve market) [s6]. On the commercial side, the December 2025 partner conference set a 2026 target of 45,000 domestic commercial vehicles, with new-energy units striving to exceed 16,000 [s11]. These are the company's stated targets and plans, not achieved results.

Our analysis

Our assessment: the 250,000-unit figure is a passenger-vehicle target. The 133,000 units reported for 2025 are Dongfeng Liuzhou Motor's total sales, not passenger-vehicle sales. The same release separates the growth of commercial vehicles, new-energy commercial vehicles and new-energy passenger vehicles, and does not call 133,000 a passenger-vehicle total, so the passenger-vehicle base is below 133,000 and the step up to 250,000 is wider than a near-doubling [s4]. The 19 September 2026 launch article says the Xinghai V6's launch-period super trade-in price starts at RMB 99,900, and that this is the first time Huawei Qiankun intelligent driving has gone below RMB 100,000 [s22]. The family large-six-seat segment is competitive, so the commercial impact remains to be proven. The overseas 2030 target was stated as 300,000 units in the June 2025 plan and as 155,000 units in later official releases, indicating the plan has been revised downward [s5][s6]. The above is our assessment, based on the data cited in this study.
outlook.zh:
公司公开规划

东风柳汽 2026 年 6 月发布的「十五五」（「725·双领先」）战略提出：商用车 7 万辆（实现南方区域市场领先）、乘用车 25 万辆（聚焦 MPV 赛道），海外 2030 年销量达 15.5 万辆，称「在海外再造一个东风柳汽」[s4]。此前 2025 年 6 月发布的「乘风双擎（2030）」计划提出：至 2030 年累计投入 200 亿元、共建 9 个海外智能制造基地、新增 300 家以上销售网络，当时提出年海外销售 30 万辆的目标[s5][s13]；到 2026 年，官方稿件将该计划的海外目标表述为 15.5 万辆[s6]。在东盟，公司规划打造越南（依托 KD 工厂）、泰国（右舵乘用车）、印尼（战略储备）三个「万辆级」市场[s6]。商用车侧，2025 年 12 月合作伙伴大会提出 2026 年冲刺国内商用车 4.5 万辆产销目标、新能源力争突破 1.6 万辆[s11]。以上为公司目标与规划表述，并非已实现结果。

我们的分析

我们的判断：25 万辆写的是乘用车目标。2025 年披露的 13.3 万辆是东风柳汽公司总销量，不是乘用车销量。同一篇稿分别给出商用车、新能源商用车和乘用车新能源的增速，没有把 13.3 万辆称为乘用车销量，所以乘用车基数低于 13.3 万辆，冲到 25 万辆的幅度比把总销量看成接近翻倍更大[s4]。2026 年 9 月 19 日上市稿写星海 V6 上市期间超级置换价低至 9.99 万元起，并写这是华为乾崑智驾首次进入 10 万元以内[s22]。家用大六座细分市场竞争激烈，其商业成效尚待观察。海外 2030 年目标在 2025 年 6 月计划中表述为 30 万辆、在 2026 年官方稿件中表述为 15.5 万辆，说明该规划已向下修订[s5][s6]。上述为我们的判断，依据为前文所引数据。

risks.en:
• Model sales mix not disclosed: the 2025 results give company sales of 133,000 units and separate growth rates for commercial vehicles, new-energy commercial vehicles and new-energy passenger vehicles, but not a Lingzhi share. This page does not state that volume depends on the Lingzhi line [s4].
  • Intense competition in the mainstream new-energy market: the RMB 100,000-250,000 band is contested by many established players, and Forthing enters it mainly through low pricing [s4].
  • Early-stage Huawei cooperation: the Huawei Qiankun partnership was signed in June 2026, the V6 began pre-sale in August 2026 and only launched in September 2026, so its commercial impact is unproven [s4][s22].
  • Heavy new-energy transition spending: Forthing announced in 2023 a plan to invest over RMB 20 billion in new-energy competitiveness and to stop producing fuel vehicles by 2030, so the transition carries cost and timing risk [s8].
  • Overseas trade and logistics risk: overseas expansion depends on logistics channels such as the Pinglu Canal, which only opened in September 2026, and on destination-market trade policy and certification requirements [s6].
  • No standalone financial disclosure: the brand publishes no standalone financial statements, so outside assessment of profitability relies on the parent's consolidated disclosures [s2].
risks.zh:
• 分车型销量未披露：2025 年成绩给出公司销量 13.3 万辆，以及商用车、新能源商用车、乘用车新能源的增速，没有菱智占比。本页不把销量写成依赖菱智序列[s4]。
  • 主流新能源市场竞争激烈：10 万–25 万元主流新能源市场头部企业众多，东风风行主要以低起售价切入，面临价格与品牌双重压力[s4]。
  • 华为合作尚处早期：与华为乾崑智驾的合作于 2026 年 6 月签约、首款车型星海 V6 于 2026 年 8 月预售、9 月才正式上市，其商业成效尚未经市场充分验证[s4][s22]。
  • 新能源转型投入大：东风风行 2023 年提出投入超 200 亿元构建新能源竞争力、2030 年停产燃油车，转型成本与节奏存在不确定性[s8]。
  • 海外贸易与物流风险：海外拓展依赖平陆运河等物流通道及所在国贸易政策与认证要求，平陆运河 2026 年 9 月才通航，出海链路尚在磨合[s6]。
  • 无单独财务披露：品牌不单独披露财务报表，外部对其盈利情况的判断需依赖母公司的合并披露[s2]。
